## What part of a project it rates

One or two sentences. Say what it covers and what it leaves to existing skills.

## Why an existing skill does not cover it

Name the closest existing skills and where they stop.

## The five levels

One line each. Each level includes the ones below it. Say when level 5 is the right choice.

1.
2.
3.
4.
5.

## Context questions

What the skill needs to know before the audit, and what it can find by reading the project.

## What it never does

Its safety limits. For example: never touches live systems, never edits product code.

## Handoffs

Which existing skills it would hand off to, and which would hand off to it.

## Levels block key

One lowercase word for its row in `LEVELS.md`, and what its `gaps` count holds.

## Contract

- [ ] I have read the contract for layer skills in `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the proposal keeps every rule, or says below which rule it breaks and why.
